notes.title: v1.0.2 FPS 100%↑~300%↑
notes.notes:
1.FPS 100%↑~300%↑
进行了重大优化，原来GTX1070最高画质30FPS，最低画质55FPS，现在最高画质60FPS，最低画质150-250FPS，提升了100%-300%

2.取消了一个密码
密码锁是随机密码，但是我特意留了一个密码，没想到竟然有人猜出来了，不知道是运气好，还是一个个试的，真是佩服，为了不影响后续玩家的体验，我决定取消这个密码

3.修改了小女孩异常
使其更明显，触发异常后，会时间变慢，并修复了重新进门后时间变慢没有停止的问题

4.修改进门后的音效问题
多次进门后会重复播放音效，可能会很吵，现在同时只会播放一次

1.FPS 100%↑~300%↑
Major optimization has been made, the original GTX1070 the highest image quality is 30FPS, the lowest image quality is 55FPS, now the highest image quality is 60FPS, and the lowest image quality is 150-250FPS, which has been increased by 100%-300%.

2. Cancel a password
The combination lock is a random password, but I deliberately left a password, I didn't expect someone to guess it, I don't know if it's luck, or try one by one, really admire, in order not to affect the experience of subsequent players, I decided to cancel this password.

3. Modified the little girl anomaly
Made it more obvious, when the anomaly is triggered, the time slows down, and fixed an issue where the time slows down after re-entering the door without stopping.

4. Fix the sound effect after entering the door
The sound effect will be repeated after multiple entrances, which can be noisy, but now it will only be played once at a time.
